parts.title: Pride Rock and the sun
parts.say: First the savanna. The sun is going down behind the land!

steps.say: Draw Pride Rock: a flat top that sticks way out, a round tip, then back in underneath and down.
Draw two little cracks on the rock.
Draw a long flat line from the rock to the edge, far away. That's where the land ends.
Draw half of a great big sun, sitting right on the line.

parts.title: Acacia tree and grass
parts.say: Far away there's a tree, and grass grows all around.

steps.say: Draw a thin tree trunk far away, standing on the line and splitting in two at the top.
Draw a wide flat top on the tree, like a big green umbrella.
Draw two pointy tufts of grass, like zigzags.

parts.title: Simba
parts.say: Simba climbs up to the top of Pride Rock!

parts.title: Sunset
parts.say: Last, the sunset sparkles, and friends come to visit Simba!

steps.say: Draw three straight lines shining up out of the sun.
Draw two more sunshine lines, one on each side.
Draw two birds flying home, like little stretched letter Ms.
Draw a butterfly's little body flying near Simba.
Give the butterfly two wings, one on each side!
